run_check_deps: run the check_deps script to verify spdl package dependencies and imported modules
run_check_package_meta: run check_package_meta to verify spdl_core has no dependencies and spdl_io lists only NumPy
run_check_imported_modules: run check_imported_modules to verify spdl.pipeline and spdl.io import without third-party libraries
run_get_imported_3rd_party_modules: run _get_imported_3rd_party_modules to list all third-party modules currently loaded in sys.modules
run_main: run the main function to execute all dependency and import checks for spdl packages
